title: Wading Pines Camping Resort

services.name: RV site
services.desc: Whether you’re planning a weekend escape or coming back again and again all season long, RV sites at Wading Pines Camping Resort give you a peaceful, wooded place to relax between adventures. Set in the heart of the southern New Jersey Pine Barrens, our RV campground offers spacious sites, tall pines, and easy access to the Wading River and all of South Jersey’s outdoor fun. Our RV sites offer the comforts you need in a setting that still feels like real camping. Whether you drive a small travel trailer, a fifth wheel, or a longer motorhome, we have options to match your setup and style. services.name: Cabin stay
services.desc: Escape to the New Jersey Pinelands and enjoy a relaxing stay in one of our 16 rustic cabin rentals at Wading Pines Camping Resort. Surrounded by tranquil, wooded scenery and many with views of the fishing pond, our cabins offer a peaceful retreat where you can unplug, sleep in a real bed, and still feel close to nature. Our cabins are true rustic camping cabins - not hotel rooms or luxury glamping tents. Each cabin has electricity, climate control, and a few simple comforts, but no bathroom or kitchen inside. services.name: Canoe & Kayak Trips
services.desc: Take a trip down the scenic Wading River, and enjoy paddle sports at their best! Come and enjoy a gentle, calm water float trip! Wading Pines offers canoeing, kayaking for all ages and skill levels. Bring a cooler and picnic lunch along, then stop and enjoy the scenery on your trip … or stop for a swim on hot days. Enjoy safe and exciting family fun! (Management recommends children be 5 years and older to participate in river activities.)
